title: Combined protein and nucleic acid staining in tissues with PANINI
protocol: Place slides with FFPE tissue samples in an oven at 70°C for 1 h.
Wash the slides with xylenes 2 × 15 min to remove residual paraffin.
Rehydrate the slides using a Linear Stainer set to 3 dips and 180s.
Fill jars on the Linear Stainer at least three-quarters full for rehydration.
Place empty “holder” jars on the left side of the Linear Stainer.
Pre-warm vertical tank with 1× PBS.
Fill slide chamber with freshly made 1× pH 9 Dako Retrieval Buffer.
Submerge slides in beaker containing 1× pH 9 Dako Retrieval buffer for HIER.
Boil slides on a hot plate for HIER.
Wash tissues with 3 × 180s xylenes washes.
Wash tissues with 2 × 180s 100% Ethanol washes.
Wash tissues with 2 × 180s 95% Ethanol washes.
Wash tissues with 1 × 180s 80% Ethanol wash.
Wash tissues with 1 × 180s 70% Ethanol wash.
Wash tissues with 3 × 180s ddH2O washes.
Store slides in ddH2O holding tank for up to an hour.
Transfer the slides from the ddH2O holding tank to a slide chamber filled with 1× pH 9 Dako Retrieval Buffer.
Place the slide chamber in the PT module prewarmed to 70°C.
Set the PT module to perform HIER at 97°C for 10 min after preheating to 70°C.
Control cooling post-HIER to 65°C using the PT module.
Remove the slide chamber containing the slides once the PT module cools to 65°C.
Allow the slides to equilibrate to room temperature.
Rinse the slides in ddH2O 2 × 2 min in Coplin jars.
Flick the slides to remove excess water.
Circle the tissue sections with a hydrophobic pen using a single stroke.
Do not allow tissues to dry out.
Perform step 7 as quickly as possible but be careful not to let the hydrophobic pen contact water.
Return slides to the ddH2O Coplin jars within 1 min to ensure that the tissues stay hydrated.
Check that the hydrophobic circle does not wash off.
Transfer slides to the slide holder within the ACD HybEZ oven pan and rinse slides 2 × 2 min in ddH2O in the ACD HybEZ oven wash trays.
Retrieve Probes from 4°C.
Place Probes in a warm water bath at 37°C–40°C without submerging them below the cap line.
Turn on the oven and prewarm it to 40°C with the tray inside.
Place a ddH2O-dampened paper towel inside the oven tray to create humidity.
If using a homemade humidity chamber, fill the base of an empty pipette tip box with water.
Place a paper towel inside the pipette tip box filled with water to retain moisture.
Drop 1–2 drops of RNAscope H2O2 on each slide to ensure adequate coverage of the tissue.
Incubate for 20 min at 40°C.
Gently spread the liquid using the tip of the dropper bottle to cover the entire section evenly.
Ensure the tip does not touch the tissue directly to avoid contamination and disruption.
Rinse slides 2 × 2 min in ddH2O in the HybEZ Oven wash pans.
Leave the oven pan at room temperature to cool during the rinse.
Add 1–2 drops of Avidin Block to each slide and incubate in the oven pan at room temperature for 15 min.
Rinse slides 2 × 2 min in ddH2O.
Add 1–2 drops of Biotin Block to each slide and incubate in the oven pan at room temperature for 15 min.
Double-check that the oven is still set to 40°C during the rinse.
Prewarm the oven pan in the oven.
Rinse slides 2 × 2 min in ddH2O, ensuring the paper towels are wet.
Add 1–2 drops of aliquoted nucleic acid probes to each slide and incubate overnight at 40°C in the dark inside a humidity chamber.
Adjust the annealing temperature and time according to your optimized assays.
Hybridize Oligopaints probe at 42°C for at least 4 h and up to 48 h.
Pause point: Ensure probes have hybridized overnight (15–18 h) if necessary.
Remove Amps 1–4 from the refrigerator to room temperature.
Place Amp1 bottle in a water bath at 37°C.
Prepare an ice bucket for storing Amps after their applications.
Remove slides from the 40°C oven.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 0.5× Wash Buffer.
Add 1–2 drops of Amp1 to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 30 min.
Pre-warm Amp2 bottle in the front nook of the oven during incubation.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 0.5× Wash Buffer.
Place pan and Amp2 back in the oven to keep warm.
Add 1–2 drops of Amp2 to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 15 min.
Pre-warm Amp3 bottle in the front of the oven during incubation.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 0.5× Wash Buffer.
Place pan and Amp3 back in the oven to keep warm.
Add 1–2 drops of Amp3 to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 30 min.
Pre-warm Amp4 HRP-C1 bottle in the front of the oven during incubation.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 0.5× Wash Buffer.
Place pan and V2 Amp4 back in the oven to keep warm.
Add 1–2 drops of V2 Amp4 to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 15 min in the dark.
Remove Amp5 and Amp6 bottles from 4°C.
Allow Amp5 and Amp6 to equilibrate to room temperature.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 0.5× Wash Buffer.
Leave the pan uncovered at room temperature to cool during washing.
Add 1-2 drops of brown kit Amp5 to each slide.
Incubate slides at room temperature for 30 min in the dark.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 1× TBS-T.
Add 1-2 drops of brown kit Amp6 to each slide.
Incubate slides at room temperature for 15 min in the dark.
Prepare TSA buffer and TSA reagents (TSA-Biotin and TSA-DIG).
Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 1× TBS-T.
Add 50-100 μL of prepared TSA-Biotin to each slide.
Incubate slides at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for 2 minutes.
Repeat wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for another 2 minutes.
Add 1–2 drops of HRP-Blocker to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 15 minutes in the dark, ensuring slides are covered.
Place Amp4 HRP C2 in the front of the oven during incubation to pre-warm it.
Wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for 2 minutes.
Repeat wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for another 2 minutes.
Place the pan and Amp4 HRP C2 back in the oven to keep warm during wash.
Add 1–2 drops of Amp4 HRP C2 to each slide.
Incubate at 40°C for 15 minutes in the dark, ensuring slides are covered.
Wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for 2 minutes.
Repeat wash in 0.5× Wash Buffer for another 2 minutes.
Add 50–100 μL of prepared TSA-DIG to each slide.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes in the dark, ensuring slides are covered.
Wash in 1× TBS-T for 2 minutes.
Repeat wash in 1× TBS-T for another 2 minutes.
Remove slides from washing solution.
Place slides in a Coplin jar and wash in Staining Wash Buffer for 5 minutes.
Repeat wash in Staining Wash Buffer for another 5 minutes.
Transfer slides to a humidity chamber.
Add approximately 100 μL of Antibody Blocking Buffer to each slide, ensuring tissues are fully covered.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Pause the procedure for up to 3 hours while allowing slides to block.
Prepare the Primary Antibody Cocktail during the blocking period.
Add 100 μL of the primary antibody cocktail per slide.
Remove slides from the humidity chamber and wash 2 × 5 minutes in Staining Wash Buffer.
Prepare the Secondary Antibody Cocktail during the washing process.
Apply the Secondary Antibody Cocktail for labeling bound primary antibodies with fluorescent-conjugated antibodies.
Add approximately 100 μL of Secondary Antibody Cocktail per slide.
Incubate the slides at room temperature for 1 hour in a humidity chamber.
Wash the slides twice with Staining Wash Buffer for 5 minutes each in Coplin jars.
Place the slides into a third Coplin jar containing 30 mL of Staining Wash Buffer and 5 μL of Hoechst, then incubate for 5 minutes in the dark.
Rinse the slides for 2 minutes in Staining Wash Buffer.
Mount a No. 1 coverslip (22 × 50 mm) over the slides using approximately 40 μL of Antifade Mounting Medium with DAPI.
Seal the coverslip with clear nail polish.
Image the slides on a fluorescent microscope.
